name: r_background
title: Start R and return its process id.

origin.description: Start R and return its process id.
origin.details: Start R and return its process id.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sys))
pid <- r_background(c("--vanilla", "-q", "--slave", "-e", "quit(status=0)"), std_out = FALSE, std_err = FALSE); cat(exec_status(pid, wait = TRUE), "\n")

translation.description: Start R and return its process id.
translation.details: Start R and return its process id.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from r_sys import exec_status, r_background
pid = r_background(["--vanilla", "-q", "--slave", "-e", "quit(status=0)"], std_out=False, std_err=False)
print(exec_status(pid, wait=True))
